lines.en: The sword is light; my steps are lighter.
The dark under the plates is hollow.

lines.zh: 我像是从别处借来的身子。
lines.en: I'm a body borrowed from elsewhere.
My feet land, but leave no print.
The sword hangs in my grip.
I go around the stone pillar slowly.

lines.zh: 穿过风的时候，甲片不响。
lines.en: Passing through wind, the plates don't ring.
I drift over toward the stones.
Every step feels weightless.
This shell is barely holding.
I still have to reach you.
One blow is enough.

lines.zh: 我停住了，甲里没有声音。
lines.en: I stop. Nothing sounds inside the armor.
I raise the bow to my shoulder.
The string shows no light.

lines.zh: 这具身子本来就是空的。
lines.en: This body was empty to begin with.
Void leaks through the seams.
I turn my helm slowly.
What's inside me is hard to see.
I lift the sword again.
I have nothing left to lose.
I count the steps between us.
A little closer.
That blow is almost here.
The dark in the seams is widening.
I grip the sword hilt.
I've saved this blade a long time.
A little grey shows in the flagstone cracks.
You're looking at my helm.
It's empty dark inside.
Not entirely empty.
Look long enough and you'll understand.
This shell is about to fall apart.
Before it does, I can still swing once.
There's nowhere to retreat to.

lines.zh: 你的火光透过了我的胸。
lines.en: Your firelight passes through my chest.
You won't hit me twice.
The first will be the last.
Your armor is too thick.

lines.zh: 不过我也只打算挥一次。
lines.en: But I only plan to swing once.
Don't blink.
There's a crack under your feet.
You broke through a bit.
A plate came off.
Void leaks through the gap.
The shell is thinner now.

lines.zh: 甲缝里漏出的暗合上了。
lines.en: The dark leaking from the seam closes up.

lines.zh: 这一下，我少了一次机会。
lines.en: That cost me one chance.
Your fist sank into the void.
My sword is still here.
A cracking sound comes from the armor.
Only this one blow left.

lines.zh: 你放在地上，我也不会去拿。
lines.en: Leave it on the ground. I won't take it.

lines.zh: 这个身子什么也不需要。
lines.en: This body needs nothing.
Keep your things.
This empty shell has no desires.

lines.zh: 你举着它，挡了自己的路。
lines.en: Holding it up blocks your own path.
I don't eat or drink.

lines.zh: 只一点血的甲，全靠手里的弓。
lines.en: One health of armor, all in the bow.
You'd best put your weapon down.
I've raised my sword.

lines.zh: 这具空壳什么也不需要。
lines.en: This empty shell needs nothing.

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上，穿过去一点。
lines.en: You hit me and passed slightly through.
This shell isn't solid.
The void pushed you back.
I stepped back and the plates rang.

lines.zh: 你碰到的只有虚空的凉。
lines.en: All you touch is the void's cold.
The void will touch you.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我听见裂缝的声音。
lines.en: We collided, and I heard a crack.
The void fills an empty suit of armor.
You're unharmed.

lines.zh: 再撞一次，我大概就散了。
lines.en: One more hit and I'd probably break apart.
There's no room for anyone in this shell.
I can't even hold myself steady.
That's too far away for me.
Leave. Quickly.
I won't be staying.
The void will take me back.

lines.zh: 那时候就什么都没有了。
lines.en: Then there'll be nothing at all.
Don't watch me.

lines.zh: 我没什么可说的，这副空壳只剩武器。
lines.en: I have nothing to say; this hollow shell keeps only weapons.
That's how it is.
It lies there beneath my palm.
My fingers pass through it.
The void swallowed it.

lines.zh: 这具壳拿不稳任何东西。
lines.en: This shell can't hold anything steady.

lines.zh: 它还在那儿，但我也碰不到。
lines.en: It's still there, but I can't touch it.
Only a scrap is left in this hollow shell.

lines.zh: 我只有一滴血，可甲很硬。
lines.en: One point of health, but hard armor.
That one was real.
Take it back.
I won't need it.
You stepped into the light.
I see you very clearly.
The bow comes up a little.
I have one arrow left.
This blade is still here too.
Try moving.
A crack opens beneath my feet.
The void is counting for me.

lines.zh: 你退到那边，我也够得到。
lines.en: Back to there, and I can still reach.
In this instant.
The bow is fully drawn.
Your position hasn't changed.
Crouched low, waiting for you to come closer.
There's only this arrow left.

lines.zh: 我跟在你后面，没有声音。
lines.en: I follow without a sound.
You turn back to nothing.
I'm right behind you, actually.
My plates look grey in the light.
Run faster.
This shell won't last long.
With every step, it thins.
Stop, and I stop too.

lines.zh: 我身上这副空甲，只有一点生命撑着。
lines.en: This empty armor runs on one point of life.
Behind the pillar is a blind corner.

lines.zh: 甲片下面空得发暗，没有身体。
lines.en: Under the plates it is hollow and dark, no body.
I don't need to chase hard.

lines.zh: 我落地的时候，灰尘都不动。
lines.en: When I land, not even the dust stirs.
I'm not tired yet.
Two more blocks.
The sword thrusts, very light.

lines.zh: 你挡住的时候，甲片裂了。
lines.en: When you blocked, my plates cracked.
I still landed it.
Your armor was cut open.
My shell split wider.
The shell thinned again.
I swing once more.
The sword is getting unsteady.
I've forced you into the corner.

lines.zh: 这一下，是我最后的一击。
lines.en: This one is my last strike.
The void seeps out first, then props up the armor.
The plates join in midair.
The void fills the helm.
The plates land with a single clink.
This body weighs like emptiness.
One look and you'll understand.
I won't stay long.
Enough time for one swing.
You'd best leave while you can.
I've raised the sword.
The plates are a pale color.

lines.zh: 甲片一片片从我身上浮起。
lines.en: My plates float up one by one around me.
I tilt my helm your way.
Then I started walking.

lines.zh: 火烧穿了甲片，缺口更大。
lines.en: Fire burned through a plate, and the gap grew.

lines.zh: 摔下去的时候，甲片散了一半。
lines.en: As I fell, half the plates scattered.

lines.zh: 水灌进壳里，虚空被搅乱了。
lines.en: Water filled the shell and churned the void.

lines.zh: 爆炸把整个壳都撕开了。
lines.en: The blast tore the whole shell open.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过甲缝，没有阻力。
lines.en: An arrow passed through the seam with no resistance.

lines.zh: 光烧过我的甲，边缘都化了。
lines.en: The light burned my armor and the edges melted.

lines.zh: 我不需要进食，只会散得更快。
lines.en: I don't need food. I only scatter faster.

lines.zh: 电顺着甲片走，壳开始崩。
lines.en: The current ran along the plates and the shell began to fail.

lines.zh: 虚空在脚下张开，我本来就是它的。
lines.en: The void opens below. I was always its.
